risk_if_not_implemented: Without Asset Discovery, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be unknown, untracked, lost, stolen or left unprotected because they are not inventoried. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Asset Inventories
compensating_control_1.justification: Asset Inventories (AST-04) provides asset and inventory visibility that compensates for the absence of Asset Discovery (AST-09) by providing the foundational asset knowledge needed to manage risks associated with the primary control. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Automated Unauthorized Component Detection
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to detect and alert upon the detection of unauthorized hardware, software and firmware components.
compensating_control_2.justification: Automated Unauthorized Component Detection (AST-11) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Asset Discovery (AST-09) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
